plan.title: 2x2 Genotype x Drug Interaction DE + Pathway Analysis
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the drug act differently in KO than in WT brain — is precisely a genotype x treatment interaction question in a 2x2 factorial (WT/KO x vehicle/drug, n=4/cell, 16 samples, 12000 genes, raw salmon counts). The plan follows the DESeq2 interaction workflow: (1) sample-structure QC via blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap to catch outliers or unexpected clustering before modeling; (2) minimal count pre-filtering; (3) a single DESeq2 model with design ~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels (WT, vehicle) so coefficients are interpretable; (4) the interaction coefficient tested first (does the drug effect differ by genotype), then the two simple effects (drug vs vehicle within WT, and within KO) via named contrasts; (5) ashr shrinkage of all three (interaction is a non-single-coefficient contrast); (6) BH FDR at alpha 0.05 per contrast with independent filtering; (7) fgsea preranked enrichment (Wald statistic) against MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome, run separately per contrast, with GO BP as a secondary pass if warranted; (8) a consolidated report presenting the interaction contrast and both simple effects side by side, diagnostic plots, and reproducibility metadata. Because only 4 replicates per cell, note the interaction test has limited power for detecting a difference-of-differences and state this explicitly in the report.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind) PCA and sample distance heatmap
Pre-filter genes with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (4)
DESeq2 design ~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment, explicit reference levels WT/vehicle
DESeq2 Wald test on interaction coefficient plus simple effect contrasts
ashr shrinkage of interaction and simple-effect contrasts
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR with independent filtering, alpha 0.05, per contrast
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, Hallmark then Reactome, per contrast
Interaction report: simple effects + interaction contrast side by side
